text:
neha: Heads-up: started getting silent failures in Next middleware on Vercel preview when calling the SDK stream API. No stack, just a dropped request and `middleware` shows 502. Local `next dev` works fine. Anyone seen silent/no-stack edge failures?
dylan: Yep. Often caused by bundling a node-only module into the edge bundle. Instead of throwing a clear error, the platform runtime sometimes just errors out during import/init and you get no useful stack.
sora: In one case we had a tiny helper that referenced `crypto.randomBytes` indirectly. SWC inlines it and the edge worker can't satisfy it -> silent crash. Removing the top-level import fixed it.
neha: Ugh. My top-level `createClient` import was enough to trigger it. Moving the import inside middleware made the crash go away. But I want a proper fix from SDK side so users don't have to restructure.
dylan: SDK action items that help: 1) provide an explicit `./edge` export and edge-only build, 2) ensure no node-only modules are imported at top-level of that build, 3) ship a tiny `edge.d.ts` that avoids Node types.
sora: Also add a CI lint that scans the dependency graph from `./dist/edge.mjs` for forbidden imports (`fs|child_process|crypto.randomBytes|util.inspect`) and fail the release if found. Saved us twice.
nana: patch-bot: opened issue RW-2219: "Edge middleware: silent failures when node modules bundled" and attached a minimal repro.
nana: Quick runtime workaround for customers: lazy-import the SDK inside middleware handler and prefer the `/edge` entry. Example: 
```js
export async function middleware(req) {
  const { createClient } = await import('redwood-inference/edge')
  const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
  await client.ping()
  return new Response(null)
}
```
neha: TS is another painpoint. Middleware compile complains about missing DOM types (`Cannot find name 'Request'`) because many apps include `@types/node` globally. We should: a) publish `edge.d.ts` referencing `dom` libs only, b) add an `examples/nextjs-edge-middleware` showing a `tsconfig.middleware.json` with "lib": ["esnext","dom"].
sora: Also remove Node-specific types from the main public typings (no Buffer/NodeJS.Timer in exported interfaces). If we must support Node, provide `node.d.ts` separate and mention in README to augment with `/// <reference types="node" />` for server usage.
dylan: Runtime retry/backoff note: don't rely on setTimeout in the edge build. Replace with AbortController-based deadlines or use `signal.timeout` when available. That fixed hanging retry loops for us.
nana: CI note: patch-bot ran `ci/edge-sanity` and failed on import graph. I'll attach that output to the issue.
neha: Plan agreed: small patch release with 1) dist/edge.mjs export, 2) dist/edge.d.ts, 3) lazy-load node-only modules, 4) replace timer-based retry in edge build, 5) add examples/nextjs-edge-middleware + tsconfig snippet. Target: tomorrow morning. I'll validate the preview once it's up and post logs. :raised_hands:
